cand.title: Club Med Punta Cana 2027 CME — English-speaking physicians
cand.excerpt: High evidence and exact competitor commitment; current accessibility is none, so value is future capture/overflow intelligence rather than open current demand.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Josh Botelho is the edition-specific reservation contact and Cameleo event-development specialist whose published remit includes finding hotels and event locations. Mélissa Rancourt is director of events and continuing professional development with scientific/logistical responsibility. Julien Martel is Cameleo president and Cléo executive director. These are relevant relationship-development contacts, not verified individual contract signatories.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed upcoming within the requested horizon: March 6–13, 2027 is the advertised Club Med stay/event week. The accredited scientific activity is March 8–11, 2027, with English-speaking family physicians and specialists as its audience. These are activity dates, not publication dates. No subsequent English-speaking Punta Cana edition was verified.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied Wyndham Alltra product specifications: an all-inclusive, guestroom-led resort is conceptually better aligned with this physician-and-family educational holiday than a city hotel. The scientific schedule includes morning sessions and the incumbent package emphasizes accompanying families and children. Alltra suitability remains conditional on actual attendance, simultaneous meeting needs, family-room mix, childcare, audiovisual requirements and economics; the supplied approximately 300-person conference capacity must not be treated as event attendance.
findings.venueCommitments: Club Med Punta Cana is the announced competing host resort for the March 6–13, 2027 edition. Edition-specific evidence goes beyond resort marketing: the brochure names the CME event, sells specific Club Med room categories at event rates, supplies payment terms, and guarantees pricing for up to three days before/after the event. The scientific programme requires accommodation through Cameleo CME. This establishes announced event-venue and lodging-package commitment, not disclosure of a signed hotel contract, a quantified guaranteed room block, exclusivity or contracted meeting-room allocation.
findings.historicalRotation: The organizer archive records Club Med Punta Cana scientific events in 2016, 2019, 2020 and every year 2022–2026. It also records Club Med Michès in 2021–2024 and Cancún in several years; these are organizer-portfolio events, not proof that this particular English-language programme rotates among them. Repeated incumbent usage is verified; an annual English-language series or mandatory rotation is not.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Hotel selection is already announced for 2027; no open hotel procurement was found. Guest accommodation must be booked through Cameleo CME, and the FAQ ties conference-seat planning to rooms booked through the agency. The edition brochure directs bookings to Josh Botelho and advertises a CAD 750 per-person deposit, balance due November 6, 2026, with the free-cancellation deadline November 5, 2026. Those deadlines precede the November 14, 2026 assessment date; they are not evidence of sellout or a reopened sourcing process. No named external DMC or PCO was verified.
findings.organizationStructure: Cléo is the nonprofit continuing-professional-development organization supervising scientific committees; it is identified as presenter of this event. Cameleo CME handles Cléo event logistics and is a licensed travel agency; its FAQ publishes Quebec travel-agency permit 703160. Club Med Punta Cana is the host hotel, not the scientific organizer. This is a nonprofit scientific-programme / commercial travel-organizer relationship, not evidence of a physician-membership association buying rooms directly.
findings.competitiveLimitations: The incumbent package combines event-specific lodging, family room categories, child services and resort activities; the 2027 brochure describes a rebuilt conference centre. The mandatory Cameleo accommodation pathway is a material barrier to independent overflow capture. No English-edition sellout, overflow allocation, shortage, displaced room demand or released block was verified. The upcoming-events listing places LAST ROOMS AVAILABLE against the separate French-language February 27–March 6 week, not against the English March 6–13 week; it must not be transferred to this candidate.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact Josh Botelho at the edition-published josh.botelho@cameleomed.com or 1-800-590-5995; request an introduction to Mélissa Rancourt for future destination/hotel planning. Acknowledge the existing 2027 Club Med placement rather than pitching a displacement RFP. Ask about the next hotel-selection cycle, Club Med exclusivity, decision participants, room-night/peak-room history, family-service requirements and meeting layouts. Propose an Alltra site inspection only if alternative resorts are considered. Ask about 2027 overflow solely as an organizer-authorized exception to the accommodation rule, without assuming any exists.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: For Wyndham Alltra, treat the announced 2027 edition as committed elsewhere, with no verified open hotel-sourcing or overflow route. This does not mean registration is closed: participant booking enquiries are invited, but remaining availability is unverified. Do not equate buying a package at Club Med with a sourcing opportunity for another resort.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: repeated Punta Cana use and a named hotel-finding contact justify future-cycle account development. There is no verified post-March-2027 English Punta Cana edition, 2028 date, rebid window or willingness to leave Club Med. Position Alltra as a potential future alternative only after establishing brand flexibility and family/meeting requirements; overflow remains a conditional question, not forecast business.
